observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 开源项目 Cohub 为 Agent 提供会话之外的持久工作空间
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Cohub 是一个开源 Agent OS，为 Agent 提供会话之外的持久工作空间，集中管理文件、会话、工具、定时任务和可复用上下文。作者 Rohan Paul 转发了该项目的介绍，并重点分析其双层记忆模型：Space 保存单个项目的完整工作状态，只把持久性知识提升到作为组织记忆的 Hub，兼顾低成本保留执行状态与选择性沉淀共享判断。
observationAnalysis.author: X：Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai)

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Elvis Saravia：AI 工程师应从零构建最小 harness 掌握上下文工程
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Elvis Saravia 提出 harness 并非千篇一律，好的 harness 应解决上下文工程问题，关键在于理解并优化系统提示词、缓存和有效工具调用等底层细节。他建议用自己喜欢的语言构建一个带基本 agent 循环、系统提示词和工具调用能力的最小 harness，在用例上测试验证并迭代，掌握这些可调旋钮后再迁移到生产级 harness。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 研究发现 AI 客服更拟人未必带来更佳体验
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 发表于《欧洲营销杂志》的研究发现，在某些情况下不那么像真人的文字聊天机器人反而获得更积极的客户反馈，打字的慢节奏让消费者有时间平复负面情绪。另一项发表于《商业研究杂志》的研究显示，能准确识别消费者愤怒等情绪状态的 AI 客服会带来更高满意度。调查还显示 1031 名澳大利亚受访者中 78% 用过自动化客服，仅 39% 感到满意。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 美光探索近 GPU NAND 闪存，可支撑更大规模 AI 模型
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 据 DigiTimes 9 月 2 日报道，美光正在研究高耐久性 NAND 闪存模块，计划部署在距离 GPU 更近的位置，当前被称为"近 GPU NAND"。该方案可让 GPU 直接访问数百 GB 的 NAND 存储池，放置在 GPU 封装内部或 PCB，工作方式类似 HBM、GDDR7；与传统 TLC 或 QLC NAND 相比密度更低，重点提升 I/O 速度和带宽。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Ethan Mollick 引述观点：AI 安全能力飙升将带火安全岗位
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Ethan Mollick 转引 @levie 的观点并评论称，AI 模型越来越擅长发现和利用漏洞，前沿模型领先、开源权重紧随其后，企业漏洞发现将成倍增加，用 AI 加人工监督来分诊和自动化修复基本是唯一出路。Mollick 表示这不一定是希望因 AI 而繁荣的岗位类型，但说明了 AI 能力变化时哪些工作有需求可能快速转移。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 新加坡科技设计大学研究发现老年群体更看重 AI 陪伴聊天机器人的真实感而非拟人化
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 新加坡科技设计大学研究人员让 140 名 60 至 89 岁老年人与其社交聊天机器人 Ami Chat 互动，研究发表于《老龄化创新》期刊。结果显示，社会关系相关三个指标（拟人化、真实性、AI 社交互动强度）在使用意愿差异中额外解释了 27%；感觉更真实、互动更具回应性时使用意愿更高，但认为机器人更像真人的参与者意愿反而更低；自评健康状况较差者使用意愿更强。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 优步全球裁员 10%，约 3300 个岗位受波及，资金转向网约车与 Robotaxi 业务
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 据彭博社报道，优步将裁减约 3300 个岗位，占全球员工总数的 10%，管理层数量将减少 20%。公司压缩管理层级、收紧远程办公（未来仅约 1% 员工可远程），并将节省的资金投向网约车、配送和 Robotaxi 业务，计划未来几年向 Robotaxi 合作项目投入超过 100 亿美元。CEO 霍斯劳沙希在公告中未提 AI 对裁员的影响，但报道指出调整的另一原因是优步希望让 AI 更多参与日常运营。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: World Labs 发布从头训练的多模态世界模型 Atlas
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: World Labs 团队宣布达成重要里程碑，发布从头训练的多模态世界模型 Atlas，称其为首个此类模型。Atlas 支持像素级精确的相机控制生成帧、从单张输入图像重建大场景、通过重构视频模拟时空、从一张或多张图像原生输出 3D 空间，以及将多张带位姿图像合成为一致的 3D 世界，并称其为目前最好的相机条件世界模型，可用于 VFX 到机器人等场景。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 阿易评 Hyde 深度长文：小团队做企业 AI 交付的三条铁律
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 阿易引用 Hyde 的企业 AI 交付长文，认为此前"AI Coding 让软件工程要死"的判断被现实打脸，企业里真正值钱的资产多在老员工脑中而从未写入系统，流程梳理本身就是交付的一部分。他拆解了文中三条铁律：把 85% 确定性问题做成标准测试集、测不通不交付；范围外需求必须调整预算、周期或范围；不为显得先进硬上 AI，老旧系统没 API 坚决不碰。他强调测试、SOW 和商业边界决定能否收回尾款。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 国内首部 AIGC 长剧《后西游记》上线芒果 TV，制作周期较传统三维动画减少 70%
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 国内首部无真人演员的 AIGC 长剧《后西游记》于 8 月 31 日上线芒果 TV 并登陆湖南卫视黄金档。芒果超媒董事长蔡怀军称，该剧 30 集、单集 40 分钟，总成本约为同类 S 级真人剧几分之一，从策划到上线时间较传统三维动画压缩 70%；制作流程为导演定情绪基调、美术完成设计、AI 团队从文生图推进到图生视频。该剧也是"广电 21 条"发布后首部"边审边播"剧集。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

analysis.summaryZh: 据《商业内幕》报道，Meta 通过软件更新关闭了数千副录像指示灯被人为破坏的 Meta AI 智能眼镜的摄像头，受影响设备不到累计销量的 0.1%。最新更新修补了此前先启动录像再遮挡指示灯的漏洞：钻掉 LED 的设备摄像头永久禁用，撕掉遮挡贴纸后摄像功能可恢复。Meta 智能眼镜 2025 年单年销量达 700 万副。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 豆包工作上新：支持多 Agents 并行与 Mac 操作电脑
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 豆包工作新增多 Agents 并行和 Mac 操作电脑两项功能。多 Agents 并行可召唤不同子 Agent 在同一任务下分别执行不同模块，成倍节省时间；Mac 操作电脑功能可实现本地 GUI 操作，无需 MCP、API、插件和 CLI 即可看懂界面并完成操作。豆包工作是字节跳动于 2026 年 8 月 25 日推出的 Agent 产品，定位为字节跳动在 AI 办公场景的统一产品入口。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: OpenAI 奥尔特曼称数据中心耗水担忧缺乏数据支撑
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 据《商业内幕》报道，OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼认为外界对 AI 耗水量的担忧已被放大成缺乏数据支撑的梗，称现代数据中心实际用水量大致相当于一栋办公楼。他此前表示 ChatGPT 平均每次查询耗水约 0.32 毫升，加州种一颗杏仁平均需 3.56 升水。盖洛普 5 月调查显示 71% 的美国人反对在所在地区兴建数据中心，18% 的受访者明确提到水资源。
observationAnalysis.author: IT之家（RSS）

analysis.summaryEn: 据《商业内幕》报道，OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼认为外界对 AI 耗水量的担忧已被放大成缺乏数据支撑的梗，称现代数据中心实际用水量大致相当于一栋办公楼。他此前表示 ChatGPT 平均每次查询耗水约 0.32 毫升，加州种一颗杏仁平均需 3.56 升水。盖洛普 5 月调查显示 71% 的美国人反对在所在地区兴建数据中心，18% 的受访者明确提到水资源。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 报道称 OpenAI Astra 模型采用 recurrent depth 推理方法，引发监测担忧
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 的 Astra 模型使用名为 recurrent depth（looped transformer）的推理方法，通过同一模型层多次处理文本来提升编码和计算机操作性能，可能让小模型表现接近大模型并降低内存与带宽成本，但会遮蔽部分或全部思维链，使人类难以读懂推理步骤。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: In accordance with the Privacy Act of 1974, as amended, and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) guidance on computer matching, the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) is providing notice of the establishment of a new matching program. Pursuant to the Payment Integrity Information Act of 2019, HHS, including its component divisions and program offices, is establishing a new matching program consisting of the computerized comparison of an HHS system of records with the Do Not Pay (DNP) Working System, which is administered by Treasury's Bureau of the Fiscal Service. observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA) now supports Apache Airflow version 3.3.1, the latest release of the popular open-source workflow orchestration framework. Amazon MWAA is a managed orchestration service for Apache Airflow that makes it easier to set up and operate end-to-end data pipelines in the cloud. Apache Airflow 3.3 introduces stateful tasks and multi-language support. With the new Task and Asset State Store, tasks can now persist durable state across retries and reruns, enabling cursor tracking and crash-safe reconnection to long-running jobs. The Language Task SDK (experimental) lets teams write task logic in Java or Go while keeping orchestration in Python. Additional improvements include expanded asset partitioning, pluggable retry policies, and bulk actions for
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for SQL Server 2019 CU32+GDR KB5102335 (RDS version 15.00.4480.2.v1) and SQL Server 2022 CU25 + GDR KB5101347 (RDS version 16.00.4262.2.v1). The GDR updates address vulnerabilities described in CVE-2026-47295 , CVE-2026-47296 , CVE-2026-54118 , CVE-2026-55002. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB now supports direct major version upgrades to version 8.0
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports in-place major version upgrades (MVU) directly from engine versions 3.6 and 4.0 to version 8.0. This upgrade capability removes the need for intermediate version upgrades and allows you to upgrade your version 3.6 or 4.0 clusters while preserving existing data, configurations, and cluster settings. Upgrading to version 8.0 provides access to the latest security patches, performance improvements, and new developer capabilities. Major version upgrades from DocumentDB 3.6 and 4.0 to 8.0 are available in all AWS regions where these versions are currently supported. To learn more about upgrading to Amazon DocumentDB 8.0, including detailed guidance on version differences and upgrade paths, visit the Amazon DocumentDB MVU documentation
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports Apache Iceberg v3 tables
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports reading from and writing to Apache Iceberg v3 tables in your data lake. Apache Iceberg is an open table format, and its v3 release adds several new features. With this launch, Amazon Redshift introduces support for default column values, row lineage, and deletion vectors. With default column values, you can define an initial value that Amazon Redshift applies when no value is provided, simplifying schema evolution as you add columns to existing tables. Row lineage exposes pseudo-columns that track each row's identity and last-updated sequence number, so you can build incremental pipelines and CDC (change data capture) workflows that process only modified rows. analysis.summaryZh: Amazon Redshift now supports reading from and writing to Apache Iceberg v3 tables in your data lake. Apache Iceberg is an open table format, and its v3 release adds several new features. With this launch, Amazon Redshift introduces support for default column values, row lineage, and deletion vectors. With default column values, you can define an initial value that Amazon Redshift applies when no value is provided, simplifying schema evolution as you add columns to existing tables. Row lineage exposes pseudo-columns that track each row's identity and last-updated sequence number, so you can build incremental pipelines and CDC (change data capture) workflows that process only modified rows. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - multicloud connectivity with Microsoft Azure in preview
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS announces the public preview of AWS Interconnect — multicloud with Microsoft Azure. Customers have been adopting multicloud strategies while migrating more applications to the cloud. They do so for many reasons including interoperability requirements, the freedom to choose technology that best suits their needs, and the ability to build and deploy applications on any environment with greater ease and speed. Previously, when interconnecting workloads across multiple cloud service providers (CSPs), customers had to go the route of a ‘do-it-yourself’ multicloud approach, leading to complexities of building and managing global multi-layered networks at scale. observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 3 (compatible with MySQL 8.0) supports MySQL 8.0.45, which includes community MySQL fixes and Aurora-specific improvements. For detailed information on this release, refer to Aurora MySQL 3 and MySQL 8.0.45 release notes. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Redshift integrates with Agent Toolkit for AWS for AI-assisted data warehouse management
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Redshift now integrates with the Agent Toolkit for AWS , enabling you to build, query, troubleshoot, and migrate to Amazon Redshift data warehouses and data lakes directly from AI agents such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Cursor. The integration pairs the AWS MCP (Model Context Protocol) server , which provides authenticated AWS API execution on your behalf — with Redshift skills : curated packages of tested procedures and reference material that help AI agents complete Redshift tasks more effectively. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery introduces Recovery Plans for orchestrated application recovery
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now offers Recovery Plans, a capability that automates the sequential launch of multi-server applications during recovery and drills. Instead of launching servers one at a time and tracking dependencies manually, you define the recovery sequence once and run it with a single action when you need it. This addresses a common challenge for customers running applications made up of databases, application tiers, and supporting services that must come up in a specific order. Recovery Plans let you group servers into sequential steps with configurable wait times between them, so your application recovers predictably and consistently every time. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon EVS now supports i7i.metal-48xl Amazon EC2 instance type
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Today, we're announcing that Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) now supports the i7i.metal-48xl Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) bare-metal instance type, offering a higher core-count option with a newer generation processor to help you realize cost-performance benefits for your VMware-based workloads on AWS. With this release, you now have more options for running your virtual machines (VMs) on Amazon EVS environments and growing your cloud presence at your own pace, as your business demands. Powered by 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors, i7i instances offer the best compute and storage performance for x86-based storage optimized instances in Amazon EC2, delivering up to 23% better compute performance and more than 10% better price performance over i4i instance
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS Lambda introduces managed runtimes in public preview for Node.js 26 and Python 3.15
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Today, AWS Lambda introduces managed runtimes in public preview, starting with Node.js 26 and Python 3.15. This gives customers, partners and upstream language communities the opportunity to try upcoming managed runtimes before their general availability (GA) release and to share their feedback with the Lambda team. Previously, Lambda managed runtimes were launched directly as GA releases. Since the runtimes could immediately be used by production workloads, the Lambda team couldn’t make changes post-GA that might impact existing functions. Managed runtimes in public preview give you a chance to test your workloads and report issues before GA—while breaking changes are still possible, so we can act on your feedback. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon RDS now supports the latest CU for Microsoft SQL Server
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for Microsoft SQL Server 2025 CU6 KB5093421 (RDS version 17.00.4055.5.v1). For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5093421. We recommend that you upgrade your Amazon RDS for SQL Server instances to apply these updates using Amazon RDS Management Console, or by using the AWS SDK or CLI. You can learn more about upgrading your database instance in the Amazon RDS SQL Server User Guide for upgrading your RDS Microsoft SQL Server DB engine .
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports July 2026 Release Update
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports the Oracle July 2026 Release Update (RU) for Oracle Database versions 19c, 21c and 26ai. We recommend upgrading to the July 2026 RU as it includes security updates for Oracle database products. Starting with July 2026 releases, the naming format for an RU in Oracle Database 19c changes to .ru- .mrp- .r . For example, the RDS for Oracle July 2026 quarterly RU for Oracle Database 19c is named 19.0.0.0.ru-2026-07.mrp-2026-07.r1. When Oracle releases a monthly Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU) for Oracle Database 19c and 26ai, Amazon RDS will make it available as an MRP version that bundles the CSPU with additional Oracle-recommended fixes. observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports multiple external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers per cluster. You can associate up to 10 OIDC identity providers with a single cluster, giving you more flexibility in how you authenticate users and workloads to your Kubernetes clusters. Many organizations use different identity providers for different user populations, such as employees, contractors, and CI/CD systems. You can now associate each of these providers directly with your cluster, without consolidating users into a single provider or running an intermediary identity broker. Each provider is configured and managed independently, so each population authenticates through its own provider and identity mapping. Your existing IAM authentication continues to work alo
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Aurora now supports PostgreSQL 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports PostgreSQL versions 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23 which include bug fixes from the PostgreSQL community and Aurora-specific enhancements. We recommend upgrading to the latest minor versions to address known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) and benefit from these improvements, as detailed in the release notes .  You can upgrade your databases during scheduled maintenance windows using automatic minor version upgrades. To simplify operations at scale, enable automatic minor version upgrades and use the AWS Organizations Upgrade Rollout Policy to orchestrate multiple upgrades in phases, validating on lower-priority environments before upgrading your most critical ones. For more information, see Upgrading Amazon Au

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: MSK Replicator now supports OAuth 2.0 (SASL/OAUTHBEARER) authentication for replication from external Apache Kafka clusters to Amazon MSK
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon MSK Replicator now supports OAuth 2.0 (SASL/OAUTHBEARER) authentication for data replication from external Apache Kafka clusters - including on-premises, self-managed on AWS, or other cloud providers - to Amazon MSK Provisioned clusters . With this capability, external Apache Kafka clusters configured with OAuth/OIDC authentication can now use MSK Replicator to migrate workloads to Amazon MSK, support disaster recovery by using MSK-based clusters as a failover or backup target and enable data distribution across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. MSK Replicator is a feature of Amazon MSK that automates data replication between Kafka clusters, eliminating the need to manage custom replication infrastructure or configure open-source tools. Previously, MSK Replicator supported SASL/S
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod enhances support for Ray
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now enhances support for Ray with built-in observability, resilient training, accelerated inference and managed development environments. Ray is a popular open-source framework for scaling AI workloads on a unified compute layer, from data processing and distributed training to reinforcement learning and model serving. Running Ray on Kubernetes at production scale can be an operational burden: job hangs, low GPU utilization from static team allocations, and multi-step observability setup. Also, lack of interactive development environment means every code change needs another job submission and familiarity with kubectl. HyperPod now brings easier development, resilient training, and accelerated inference to Ray. Data scientists create, edit, monitor, and delete Ray
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS ParallelCluster 3.16 adds an on-node diagnostics tool
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS ParallelCluster 3.16 is now generally available with a new on-node diagnostics tool, cluster stability improvements, and an updated HPC and AI/ML software stack. pcluster-diag is a diagnostics tool built into the ParallelCluster AMIs that lets you run diagnostic checks on any cluster node with a single command, and get a structured report that makes it easier to identify issues. This release also hardens the cluster lifecycle with more resilient cluster creation, updates, and image builds. The software stack is refreshed, with updated NVIDIA driver, CUDA, EFA installer, and Slurm versions. To get started with pcluster-diag, see Troubleshooting with pcluster-diag . observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon RDS for MySQL now supports new minor version 8.4.11
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Starting today, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for MySQL supports MySQL minor version 8.4.11, the latest minor released by community MySQL. In addition to operational improvements, MySQL 8.4.11 introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in-transit. We recommend upgrading to the newer minor versions to accept fixes for CVEs in prior versions of MySQL and to benefit from bug fixes, performance improvements, and new functionality added by the MySQL community. Learn more about the enhancements in RDS for MySQL 8.4.11 in the Amazon RDS user guide and MySQL 8.4.11 release notes. You can leverage automatic minor version upgrades to automatically upgrade your databases to more recent

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon SES now supports open and click tracking override parameters
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now supports open and click tracking override parameters in the SendEmail and SendBulkEmail APIs. Senders can enable or disable open tracking and click tracking on an individual API call, rather than managing tracking preferences through separate configuration sets. Previously, controlling tracking behavior required maintaining a distinct configuration set for each combination of open- and click-tracking settings. With this new capability, you specify the tracking preference directly in the send request, reducing configuration overhead and simplifying how you honor recipient-level tracking consent. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Video generation models as world simulators
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re developing a blueprint for evaluating the risk that a large language model (LLM) could aid someone in creating a biological threat. In an evaluation involving both biology experts and students, we found that GPT-4 provides at most a mild uplift in biological threat creation accuracy. While this uplift is not large enough to be conclusive, our finding is a starting point for continued research and community deliberation.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving mathematical reasoning with process supervision
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a model to achieve a new state-of-the-art in mathematical problem solving by rewarding each correct step of reasoning (“process supervision”) instead of simply rewarding the correct final answer (“outcome supervision”). In addition to boosting performance relative to outcome supervision, process supervision also has an important alignment benefit: it directly trains the model to produce a chain-of-thought that is endorsed by humans.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Forecasting potential misuses of language models for disinformation campaigns and how to reduce risk
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: OpenAI researchers collaborated with Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology and the Stanford Internet Observatory to investigate how large language models might be misused for disinformation purposes. The collaboration included an October 2021 workshop bringing together 30 disinformation researchers, machine learning experts, and policy analysts, and culminated in a co-authored report building on more than a year of research. This report outlines the threats that language models pose to the information environment if used to augment disinformation campaigns and introduces a framework for analyzing potential mitigations. Read the full report here.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We trained a neural network to play Minecraft by Video PreTraining (VPT) on a massive unlabeled video dataset of human Minecraft play, while using only a small amount of labeled contractor data. With fine-tuning, our model can learn to craft diamond tools, a task that usually takes proficient humans over 20 minutes (24,000 actions). Our model uses the native human interface of keypresses and mouse movements, making it quite general, and represents a step towards general computer-using agents.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving verifiability in AI development
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve contributed to a multi-stakeholder report by 58 co-authors at 30 organizations, including the Centre for the Future of Intelligence, Mila, Schwartz Reisman Institute for Technology and Society, Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, and Center for Security and Emerging Technologies. This report describes 10 mechanisms to improve the verifiability of claims made about AI systems. Developers can use these tools to provide evidence that AI systems are safe, secure, fair, or privacy-preserving. Users, policymakers, and civil society can use these tools to evaluate AI development processes.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Deep double descent
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We show that the double descent phenomenon occurs in CNNs, ResNets, and transformers: performance first improves, then gets worse, and then improves again with increasing model size, data size, or training time. This effect is often avoided through careful regularization. While this behavior appears to be fairly universal, we don’t yet fully understand why it happens, and view further study of this phenomenon as an important research direction.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: GPT-2: 1.5B release
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As the final model release of GPT-2’s staged release, we’re releasing the largest version (1.5B parameters) of GPT-2 along with code and model weights to facilitate detection of outputs of GPT-2 models. While there have been larger language models released since August, we’ve continued with our original staged release plan in order to provide the community with a test case of a full staged release process. We hope that this test case will be useful to developers of future powerful models, and we’re actively continuing the conversation with the AI community on responsible publication.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Solving Rubik’s Cube with a robot hand
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a pair of neural networks to solve the Rubik’s Cube with a human-like robot hand. The neural networks are trained entirely in simulation, using the same reinforcement learning code as OpenAI Five paired with a new technique called Automatic Domain Randomization (ADR). The system can handle situations it never saw during training, such as being prodded by a stuffed giraffe. This shows that reinforcement learning isn’t just a tool for virtual tasks, but can solve physical-world problems requiring unprecedented dexterity.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Fine-tuning GPT-2 from human preferences
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve fine-tuned the 774M parameter GPT-2 language model using human feedback for various tasks, successfully matching the preferences of the external human labelers, though those preferences did not always match our own. Specifically, for summarization tasks the labelers preferred sentences copied wholesale from the input (we’d only asked them to ensure accuracy), so our models learned to copy. Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Emergent tool use from multi-agent interaction
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve observed agents discovering progressively more complex tool use while playing a simple game of hide-and-seek. Through training in our new simulated hide-and-seek environment, agents build a series of six distinct strategies and counterstrategies, some of which we did not know our environment supported. The self-supervised emergent complexity in this simple environment further suggests that multi-agent co-adaptation may one day produce extremely complex and intelligent behavior.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Testing robustness against unforeseen adversaries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed a method to assess whether a neural network classifier can reliably defend against adversarial attacks not seen during training. Our method yields a new metric, UAR (Unforeseen Attack Robustness), which evaluates the robustness of a single model against an unanticipated attack, and highlights the need to measure performance across a more diverse range of unforeseen attacks.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: GPT-2: 6-month follow-up
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing the 774 million parameter GPT-2 language model after the release of our small 124M model in February, staged release of our medium 355M model in May, and subsequent research with partners and the AI community into the model’s potential for misuse and societal benefit. We’re also releasing an open-source legal agreement to make it easier for organizations to initiate model-sharing partnerships with each other, and are publishing a technical report about our experience in coordinating with the wider AI research community on publication norms.

We’ll jointly develop new Azure AI supercomputing technologies, and Microsoft will become our exclusive cloud provider—so we’ll be working hard together to further extend Microsoft Azure’s capabilities in large-scale AI systems.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why responsible AI development needs cooperation on safety
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a policy research paper identifying four strategies that can be used today to improve the likelihood of long-term industry cooperation on safety norms in AI: communicating risks and benefits, technical collaboration, increased transparency, and incentivizing standards. Our analysis shows that industry cooperation on safety will be instrumental in ensuring that AI systems are safe and beneficial, but competitive pressures could lead to a collective action problem, potentially causing AI companies to under-invest in safety. We hope these strategies will encourage greater cooperation on the safe development of AI and lead to better global outcomes of AI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: MuseNet
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve created MuseNet, a deep neural network that can generate 4-minute musical compositions with 10 different instruments, and can combine styles from country to Mozart to the Beatles. MuseNet was not explicitly programmed with our understanding of music, but instead discovered patterns of harmony, rhythm, and style by learning to predict the next token in hundreds of thousands of MIDI files. MuseNet uses the same general-purpose unsupervised technology as GPT-2, a large-scale transformer model trained to predict the next token in a sequence, whether audio or text.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: OpenAI Five is the first AI to beat the world champions in an esports game, having won two back-to-back games versus the world champion Dota 2 team, OG, at Finals this weekend. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Implicit generation and generalization methods for energy-based models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve made progress towards stable and scalable training of energy-based models (EBMs) resulting in better sample quality and generalization ability than existing models. Generation in EBMs spends more compute to continually refine its answers and doing so can generate samples competitive with GANs at low temperatures, while also having mode coverage guarantees of likelihood-based models. We hope these findings stimulate further research into this promising class of models.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AI safety needs social scientists
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a paper arguing that long-term AI safety research needs social scientists to ensure AI alignment algorithms succeed when actual humans are involved. Properly aligning advanced AI systems with human values requires resolving many uncertainties related to the psychology of human rationality, emotion, and biases. The aim of this paper is to spark further collaboration between machine learning and social science researchers, and we plan to hire social scientists to work on this full time at OpenAI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How AI training scales
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve discovered that the gradient noise scale, a simple statistical metric, predicts the parallelizability of neural network training on a wide range of tasks. Since complex tasks tend to have noisier gradients, increasingly large batch sizes are likely to become useful in the future, removing one potential limit to further growth of AI systems. More broadly, these results show that neural network training need not be considered a mysterious art, but can be rigorized and systematized.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning concepts with energy functions
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed an energy-based model that can quickly learn to identify and generate instances of concepts, such as near, above, between, closest, and furthest, expressed as sets of 2d points. Our model learns these concepts after only five demonstrations. We also show cross-domain transfer: we use concepts learned in a 2d particle environment to solve tasks on a 3-dimensional physics-based robot.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning complex goals with iterated amplification
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re proposing an AI safety technique called iterated amplification that lets us specify complicated behaviors and goals that are beyond human scale, by demonstrating how to decompose a task into simpler sub-tasks, rather than by providing labeled data or a reward function. Although this idea is in its very early stages and we have only completed experiments on simple toy algorithmic domains, we’ve decided to present it in its preliminary state because we think it could prove to be a scalable approach to AI safety.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Glow: Better reversible generative models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We introduce Glow, a reversible generative model which uses invertible 1x1 convolutions. It extends previous work on reversible generative models and simplifies the architecture. Our model can generate realistic high resolution images, supports efficient sampling, and discovers features that can be used to manipulate attributes of data. We’re releasing code for the model and an online visualization tool so people can explore and build on these results.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve obtained state-of-the-art results on a suite of diverse language tasks with a scalable, task-agnostic system, which we’re also releasing. Our approach is a combination of two existing ideas: transformers and unsupervised pre-training. These results provide a convincing example that pairing supervised learning methods with unsupervised pre-training works very well; this is an idea that many have explored in the past, and we hope our result motivates further research into applying this idea on larger and more diverse datasets.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Competitive self-play
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core part of powerful AI systems in the future.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: More on Dota 2
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Our Dota 2 result shows that self-play can catapult the performance of machine learning systems from far below human level to superhuman, given sufficient compute. In the span of a month, our system went from barely matching a high-ranked player to beating the top pros and has continued to improve since then. Supervised deep learning systems can only be as good as their training datasets, but in self-play systems, the available data improves automatically as the agent gets better.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning from human preferences
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: One step towards building safe AI systems is to remove the need for humans to write goal functions, since using a simple proxy for a complex goal, or getting the complex goal a bit wrong, can lead to undesirable and even dangerous behavior. In collaboration with DeepMind’s safety team, we’ve developed an algorithm which can infer what humans want by being told which of two proposed behaviors is better.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to cooperate, compete, and communicate
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Multiagent environments where agents compete for resources are stepping stones on the path to AGI. Multiagent environments have two useful properties: first, there is a natural curriculum—the difficulty of the environment is determined by the skill of your competitors (and if you’re competing against clones of yourself, the environment exactly matches your skill level). Second, a multiagent environment has no stable equilibrium: no matter how smart an agent is, there’s always pressure to get smarter. These environments have a very different feel from traditional environments, and it’ll take a lot more research before we become good at them.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enterprise-Grade Precision for Long-Context Multimodal Embedding Inference on Cloud TPU
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud has natively integrated TPU support into the vLLM serving engine, allowing developers to elastically scale high-demand embedding pipelines using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). To handle massive 15K+ token contexts for models like Qwen3-Embedding-8B, the engineering team implemented TPU-specific optimizations such as hardware-safe tensor alignment, JAX/XLA compilation pre-warming, and a hybrid StepPool architecture for chunked prefill management. These enhancements achieve near-perfect numerical parity with reference GPU baselines, and developers can immediately leverage the open-sourced setup recipes on the AI-Hypercomputer GitHub to build their own high-throughput semantic retrieval applications.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How to Evaluate Live & Voice Agents in ADK
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Moving live voice agents from demo to production requires rigorous, automated testing to handle the unpredictability of real multi-turn conversations. ADK now provides native live evaluation, allowing developers to test graph-based agent workflows against LLM-driven simulated users that generate actual audio via Gemini TTS. By defining evaluation scenarios and natural-language rubrics, you can automatically score audio responses and tool executions, inspect the resulting transcripts in ADK Web, or run the CLI directly in your CI/CD pipeline.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Build zero-trust AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Building autonomous AI agents that mutate production state requires moving beyond soft system prompts to a robust zero-trust architecture. To secure Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) workflows against prompt injections and malicious execution, developers must implement hardware-backed cryptographic signatures for database writes, kernel-level sandboxing with gVisor for dynamic code, and deterministic semantic gateways for I/O validation. By enforcing these hard security boundaries at the infrastructure level, you can safely deploy multi-tool AI agents without risking unauthorized data manipulation or server compromise.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: HeyGen x Google Cloud: Bringing Avatar IV to TPUs
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: HeyGen ported their 18B+ parameter Avatar IV video generation model to Google Cloud's Trillium (v6e) TPUs via torchax and XLA, utilizing FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism across an eight-chip mesh. To achieve a 1.86x speedup for real-time streaming, the engineering team pipelined exposed all-to-all collectives, aligned sparse attention block sizes to eliminate mask padding, and bypassed softmax serial dependencies using a precomputed Cauchy-Schwarz upper bound. These custom Pallas kernel and compiler optimizations were deployed only after passing rigorous two-tier quality gates to guarantee byte-identical or mathematically equivalent pixel outputs.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Credentio is a newly released, open-source C++ library from Google that allows developers to integrate high-performance, local-first validation of C2PA Content Credentials into their client and server applications. By processing assets entirely locally with a highly optimized memory footprint, the library delivers instant validation verdicts for multi-gigabyte media files without incurring cloud latency, bandwidth costs, or data privacy risks. The library currently features deep manifest parsing alongside configurable trust list integration, and is available now on Google Source with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why Go is an Ideal Language for AI-Assisted Software Engineering
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As AI coding assistants shift the developer's primary role from writing boilerplate to reviewing and maintaining systems, language choice becomes critical for long-term architectural integrity. Go directly addresses this new paradigm by utilizing its strict compiler, integrated toolchain, and uncompromising readability to provide deterministic guardrails that help AI models self-correct and generate highly standardized code. By enforcing ecosystem-wide consistency and strict backward compatibility, the Go platform empowers engineering teams to efficiently verify, optimize, and maintain high-velocity, AI-generated output in production environments.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Agent Plugins package your skills, tools, and more
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 is a new, vendor-neutral directory specification—backed by Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and others—for packaging Agent Skills and MCP servers into a single portable unit. By standardizing the manifest (plugin.json) and utilizing a fixed directory layout, it eliminates the need for developers to maintain separate wrappers or configurations to support different AI coding agents and IDEs. Google has officially joined as a Core Maintainer and already rolled out support in the Agents CLI and Data Agent Kit, allowing developers to start building and distributing interoperable plugins today.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling AI Agent Infrastructure with the MCP Stateless updates
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: The 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification replaces legacy stateful constraints with a fully stateless core, enabling cloud-native horizontal scaling, serverless deployments, and standard round-robin load balancing. This architectural shift introduces standardized HTTP headers for efficient routing without deep packet inspection, caching controls, and Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR) to handle interactive and long-running tasks without blocking connections. Developers can immediately begin migrating their agentic applications to this highly scalable infrastructure using the newly available beta SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and C#.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud API Gateway now offers a model routing feature in Public Preview, allowing developers to dynamically route traffic to models like Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Developers can easily configure these routing rules directly within their OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling real-time AI agents with session-aware load balancing
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Real-time AI agents break traditional request-response load balancing paradigms because they rely on long-lived, stateful bidirectional streams that obscure true server capacity. To solve this, developers must implement application-level session tracking directly within the runtime to accurately measure the committed concurrent workload of active conversations. By feeding these precise session counts alongside standard CPU utilization metrics into a hybrid routing algorithm, infrastructure can effectively distribute stateful AI traffic and prevent individual backend bottlenecks.

By feeding these precise session counts alongside standard CPU utilization metrics into a hybrid routing algorithm, infrastructure can effectively distribute stateful AI traffic and prevent individual backend bottlenecks.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enable on-demand expertise with Agent Skills in Genkit Go
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: To prevent context window bloat and reduce token consumption, Genkit Go introduces Agent Skills based on a progressive disclosure architecture. Developers can package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles where only the frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent's system prompt. When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How to use Google microbenchmarks for evaluating TPU performance
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google's open-source TPU microbenchmark suite provides developers with granular performance metrics across Network, Compute, HBM, Host Transfer, and Attention components to validate real-world hardware capabilities. By leveraging these benchmarks to establish a Roofline model, engineers can accurately diagnose whether their machine learning workloads are compute-, memory-, or network-bound. This empirical baseline directly guides targeted software optimizations—such as kernel tuning, mesh sharding, and rematerialization—to maximize hardware utilization for large-scale model deployments.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 2: Ray AI libraries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: This second installment explores how Ray’s higher-level libraries—Serve, Data, and Train—abstract the complexities of running AI workloads on Google's TPU slices. Ray Serve uses a simple topology configuration to correctly gang-schedule large multi-host models, while Ray Data eliminates data-loading bottlenecks by feeding accelerators directly with native JAX batches. Finally, JaxTrainer streamlines distributed training across TPUs by automatically handling cross-slice coordination, checkpointing, and fault tolerance.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling Agentic RL: High-Throughput Agentic Training with Tunix
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Tunix is Google’s new JAX-native post-training library designed to eliminate TPU idling bottlenecks when training multi-turn, tool-using LLM reasoning agents. It maximizes hardware throughput by combining highly concurrent, asynchronous rollouts with a decoupled producer-consumer pipeline, ensuring the trainer is constantly fed even while agents wait on network I/O or environment steps. Additionally, Tunix provides plug-and-play abstractions and continuous macro-level profiling, allowing developers to easily integrate custom open-source environments and optimize complex distributed workflows without massive code rewrites.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 1: The foundations
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Ray 2.55 introduces official, first-class support for Google Cloud TPUs, enabling developers to run distributed Python workloads on Google's accelerators using the familiar Ray task-and-actor APIs. To handle the strict networking requirement of keeping multi-host TPU "slices" together over their Inter-Chip Interconnect (ICI), the KubeRay Operator on GKE automatically provisions and labels the underlying hardware layout. Ray Core utilizes these labels via its slice_placement_group() primitive to atomically reserve complete slices, allowing developers to deploy jobs through KubeRay, Ray Train, or Ray Serve simply by declaring a hardware topology (like "4x4") without writing custom placement code.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: To resolve the scaling bottlenecks and runtime errors caused by monolithic system prompts, engineering teams should treat prompts as build artifacts by modularizing instructions into reusable templates. By running these modular "skill files" through a transpiler, developers can enforce static validation, catch missing dependencies at build time, and integrate prompt generation directly into their CI/CD pipelines. This deterministic approach prevents code drift and ultimately establishes a safe framework where agents can propose updates to their own logic via standard pull requests.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Evolving Spec-Driven Development: Conductor Now Supports Antigravity
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Conductor has evolved from a Gemini CLI extension into a portable plugin, bringing conversational Spec-Driven Development (SDD) to ecosystems like Antigravity CLI and Claude. Rather than relying on strict command sequences, developers can now chat naturally with their AI assistant while it dynamically manages persistent markdown artifacts (like spec.md and plan.md) in the background. This update eliminates workflow friction while ensuring your repository remains a version-controlled, single source of truth for your project's architecture and state across different AI tools.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机拥有 1.2 米抗跌落能力，雷军称媲美直板旗舰
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，小米创办人、董事长兼 CEO 雷军今晚发文，预热小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机。 IT之家注：小米 18 Fold 手机将于 9 月 7 日（下周一）晚 7 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上正式发布，首发玄戒 O3 旗舰处理器。 据雷军介绍，小米 18 Fold 拥有 1.2 米抗跌落能力，可靠性媲美直板旗舰；相比小米 MIX Fold 4 手机，尖锐物体抗冲击性提升 258%，钢球重物跌落高度提升 214%。 小米 18 Fold 采用新一代小米龙骨转轴，自然水滴形态，三级连杆结构，全贴合保护。 小米 18 Fold 搭载全新双层 UTG 超薄玻璃，屏幕强度、抗冲击性大幅提升。 此外，小米 18 Fold 前后双面搭载小米龙晶玻璃 3.0，中框采用航天级 7 系铝合金。 小米官方今日公布了小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图，新机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计，后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框。 相关阅读： 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机将搭载小爱灵感球：轻松一拖即可完成各类任务 》 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图发布：极窄四等边、跑道型 Deco，新色命名「西野红」 》 《 雷军：小米 18 Fold“中折叠”旗舰手机搭载 Xiaomi MiMo 端侧大模型 》 《 小米 18 Fold 手机外观亮相：新形态命名“中折叠”，卢伟冰预测将成下一代折叠屏主流选择 》 《 小米迄今最高端手机：雷军晒 18 Fold 阔折叠真机，红色外壳、首发玄戒 O3 芯片 》

analysis.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，小米创办人、董事长兼 CEO 雷军今晚发文，预热小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机。 IT之家注：小米 18 Fold 手机将于 9 月 7 日（下周一）晚 7 点在小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上正式发布，首发玄戒 O3 旗舰处理器。 据雷军介绍，小米 18 Fold 拥有 1.2 米抗跌落能力，可靠性媲美直板旗舰；相比小米 MIX Fold 4 手机，尖锐物体抗冲击性提升 258%，钢球重物跌落高度提升 214%。 小米 18 Fold 采用新一代小米龙骨转轴，自然水滴形态，三级连杆结构，全贴合保护。 小米 18 Fold 搭载全新双层 UTG 超薄玻璃，屏幕强度、抗冲击性大幅提升。 此外，小米 18 Fold 前后双面搭载小米龙晶玻璃 3.0，中框采用航天级 7 系铝合金。 小米官方今日公布了小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图，新机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计，后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框。 相关阅读： 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机将搭载小爱灵感球：轻松一拖即可完成各类任务 》 《 小米 18 Fold“中折叠”手机官图发布：极窄四等边、跑道型 Deco，新色命名「西野红」 》 《 雷军：小米 18 Fold“中折叠”旗舰手机搭载 Xiaomi MiMo 端侧大模型 》 《 小米 18 Fold 手机外观亮相：新形态命名“中折叠”，卢伟冰预测将成下一代折叠屏主流选择 》 《 小米迄今最高端手机：雷军晒 18 Fold 阔折叠真机，红色外壳、首发玄戒 O3 芯片 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 全球最大游戏模组网站 Nexus Mods 接手 SteamDB 数据库运营
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，全球最大游戏模组网站 Nexus Mods 今日宣布接手 SteamDB 数据库运营。 IT之家注：SteamDB 是一个收集 Steam 平台游戏信息的第三方数据库。用户可在此查看各个 Steam 游戏信息，包括玩家数量趋势图、各地区价格对比、版本更新历史等，该网站由 xPaw 和 Marlamin 创立于 2013 年。 SteamDB 现已将平台运营权转交给 Nexus Mods。针对此次变动，双方均发布了声明。 SteamDB 创始人 xPaw 表示，随着共同创始人 Marlamin 离开等情况发生，SteamDB 这个项目当前已经只有他一个人维护，工作量相当于全职工作。 随着疫情、AI 兴起等情况发生，xPaw 对 SteamDB 项目的热情逐渐消退， 他自身几乎处于“职业倦怠”状态 。他曾在几年前寻求易主，但苦于没有合适的团队接手。与此同时，Steam 平台本身越来越庞大，xPaw 对海量数据的掌控越来越困难，他自己的精神压力也越来越大。 另一方面， xPaw 本人不想让 SteamDB 处于散养状态自生自灭 。今年 1 月起，他开始寻找值得信赖、能够接手 SteamDB 的合作伙伴。 最终 xPaw 选择与 Nexus Mods 合作。他看中对方二十多年持续经营游戏社区的经历，认为对方能够理解“对社群负责”这一理念。 Nexus Mods 方面表示， SteamDB 今后将作为独立服务持续运营 ，保留现有社区和品牌身份。他们今后将继续免费提供 SteamDB 的现有功能，浏览器扩展程序也将得到维护。未来 Nexus Mods 计划为 SteamDB 提供适当的资金和人员支持，并进一步加强基础设施、安全性以及服务的可扩展性。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 古尔曼曝光苹果 iPhone Ultra 折叠屏手机更多细节，支持应用并排显示、内容拖拽操作
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，下周，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Ultra 将在 9 月发布会上正式亮相。如今距离发布仅剩一周，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）在接受 Tom's Guide 采访时又透露了不少新信息，涉及硬件规格、软件功能、上市时间以及售价等多个方面，其中还有一些此前从未曝光的细节。 距离 iPhone Ultra 发布还有一周，但相关爆料仍在不断出现。古尔曼在此次采访中分享了多个新消息，其中部分内容此前尚未被报道。 MagSafe 是否会出现在 iPhone Ultra 上，此前一直存在疑问。不过，古尔曼明确表示，这款折叠屏 iPhone 不会取消 MagSafe。他表示：“MagSafe 会存在。是的，根据我听到的所有消息，这款折叠手机会配备 MagSafe。” 谈到 iPhone Ultra 的硬件规格时，古尔曼透露，这款手机将配备 5.5 英寸外屏和 7.8 英寸内屏，并搭载“最新一代苹果 Pro 芯片”和“最新一代苹果基带”。 对于外界关注的“无折痕”屏幕和液态金属铰链两项功能，古尔曼也进行了回应。他表示，iPhone Ultra 的屏幕折痕并不会完全消失，但效果将与三星最新的折叠屏手机相当，甚至可能更好，而这得益于更加耐用的铰链设计。 谈到铰链和整机耐用性时，古尔曼表示，苹果的目标是让这款折叠屏手机拥有与其他 iPhone 相当、至少非常接近的耐用程度，而耐用性也是苹果投入大量时间和精力解决的问题之一。 多任务处理同样是此次采访中重点讨论的功能之一。古尔曼此前曾透露，iOS 27 将支持类似 iPad 的应用布局，并允许用户并排运行多个应用，虽然不会达到 iPad Pro 级的多任务处理水平，但会比目前 iPhone 上的多任务处理体验更好。此次他进一步表示， 系统还将支持在多个屏幕上的应用之间进行拖放操作，用户可以快

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 华为海外发布 FreeBuds Neo 降噪耳机：短柄设计，首发 109 欧元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，华为今日在海外发布了 FreeBuds Neo 耳机，官方售价为 129 欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,007 元人民币） ， 首发优惠价 109 欧元 （现汇率约合 850.9 元人民币） 。 FreeBuds Neo 搭载专为抑制中高频噪声设计的双通道系统，能够有效过滤风噪与周围环境的交谈杂音，在全频段内 最高可提供 30 dB 的降噪深度 。 这款耳机搭载了华为 第三代音频芯片 ，能够随周围环境的变化实现毫秒级自适应降噪调节。华为表示，这项技术有效缓解了环境噪声突变时某些主动降噪耳机容易产生的突发性耳压感。 该耳机配备三麦克风与骨传导麦克风协同拾音阵列，在强力抑制环境噪音的同时精准增强人声频段。官方宣称即使身处背景噪声高达 95 dB 或风速达到 9 m/s 的环境中，通话语音依然能够保持纯净、清晰且自然。 续航表现方面，单耳在开启主动降噪状态下可连续播放 6.5 小时音频（关闭降噪为 10 小时）；配合充电盒，整机综合续航最高可达 40 小时。 该耳机支持 IP55 级防尘防水，提供星际银 (Stellar Silver)、星云粉 (Nebula Pink)、冰霜白 (Ice White) 以及星空黑 (Starry Black) 四种颜色。 单只耳机重量约 4.8 克，耳机轮廓设计参考了海量人耳形状样本数据，以实现更均匀的受力分布，有效分散佩戴压力。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 宏碁推出第四代 Vero 环保消费笔电，支持至少 2 代处理器升级
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁 (Acer) 今日宣布推出第四代 Vero 未来环保版消费级笔记本电脑 Vero 16 (V16-I71／V16-I71T)。 其在延续减量 (Reduce)、复用 (Reuse)、循环 (Recycle)“3R”设计的同时， 将概念扩展延伸至可维修性、可升级性维度 。 新一代 Vero 16 笔电搭载第 3 代英特尔酷睿 Ultra 处理器，至高可选 X9 388H；支持至高 32GB LPDDR5X 内存和 512GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD 存储；搭载 16" 16:10 OLED 屏幕；具备 Wi-Fi 7 无线网卡；提供 5MP IR 摄像头；内置 71Whr 电池；质量 1.56kg。 这款机型上盖、掌托采用 50% 工业后回收铝材与 50% 低碳铝材，底盖采用 60% 消费后回收塑料，屏幕边框采用 30% 消费后回收塑料；机身刻有浅显易懂的维修升级指引，底盖采用快拆卡扣设计，电池与固态硬盘均支持用户更换。 此外，这款笔电的轴承可与机身分离，机身两侧的 I/O 接口保护盖可拆卸， 支持至少 2 代处理器升级 。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 消息称月之暗面启动港股 IPO 流程，本周已向港交所秘密交表
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，晚点 LatePost 今天（2 日）晚间爆料称，月之暗面已于本周 以保密形式向港交所递交 A1 文件 ，正式启动港股 IPO 流程。月之暗面对此则回应称：“对于市场传闻不予置评，目前暂无可以披露的信息。” 据悉，A1 是企业申请在港交所上市时提交的正式申请表之一。 消息称月之暗面同时也在以 500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,368.46 亿元人民币） 的投前估值推进新一轮融资，这很有可能是 Kimi IPO 前的最后一轮融资。 今年 7 月，月之暗面完成了 超 35 亿美元 （现汇率约合 235.79 亿元人民币） F 轮融资 ，投后估值涨至 350 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,357.92 亿元人民币） 。因认购金额超出原定目标 3 倍有余，本轮融资提前关闭。随后有消息称，月之暗面计划 最早 8 月以内 提交香港 IPO 申请，或募资约 30 亿美元。然而，月之暗面当时回应称 消息不实 。 相关阅读： 《 月之暗面回应“最早于本月内提交香港 IPO 申请”传闻：消息不实 》 《 消息称月之暗面 Kimi 启动 Pre-IPO 融资，估值达 500 亿美元 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 微软证实 Xbox 发生大规模服务中断，多平台账号登录受影响
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，微软 Xbox 已经确认发生一起“大规模服务中断”，PC、Xbox Series X/S 以及其他设备上的用户均受到账号相关问题影响。 如果你发现自己的 Xbox 账号无法登录，无法正常玩游戏，那么并不是只有你遇到了这个问题。今天已经有大量用户报告相关故障，微软也已经正式确认了这一问题。 Xbox Support 服务状态页面显示，此次事件属于“大规模服务中断”。受影响的用户“可能无法登录 Xbox 个人资料，可能会在登录状态下被强制断开连接，或者遇到其他相关问题”。 与此同时，大多数需要登录账号才能使用的功能也将无法正常工作，包括大多数游戏、应用以及社交功能。 目前已知受影响的平台包括 Xbox Series X/S、Xbox One、Xbox 360、Windows 版 Xbox、Android、iPhone、云服务以及网页版服务。 截至IT之家发稿，微软仍在处理故障，距离确认问题已经过去约 4 个小时。微软目前尚未公布此次服务中断的具体原因。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 网易云音乐鸿蒙尝鲜内测版 App 获 9.5.82 升级，优化后台播放、音频切换等
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，网易云音乐鸿蒙尝鲜内测版今日推送了 9.5.82(9050820) 版本升级（依旧需要在“应用尝鲜”专区下载更新）。 IT之家附网易云音乐此次更新内容如下： 优化后台播放，减少长时间播放时的卡顿 优化音频切换，切回扬声器时自动暂停播放 完善锁屏和控制中心的歌词展示 修复 App 下载时通知栏异常出现下载提示的问题 提升搜索、单曲和“我的”等核心页面的稳定性 优化网络请求处理，提升多任务场景下的稳定性 修复 H5 顶栏错位、青少年模式图标异常及部分崩溃问题 网易云音乐鸿蒙版于 8 月 31 日上架华为应用市场 App Gallery 应用商店，并在“应用尝鲜”专区开放下载。 华为终端 BG CEO 何刚透露，网易云音乐鸿蒙尝鲜内测版是华为、网易双方共同开发的尝鲜版本，优先带来了音乐播放、推荐、搜索、分享等核心听歌功能，以及用户常用的歌曲评论区，更多功能还在加紧开发完善。 相关阅读： 《 网易云音乐 9.5.80 版本上线鸿蒙尝鲜，界面和安卓版有所不同 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋呼吁 G20 成员国加快发展、应用 AI，以促进经济增长
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据彭博社今天（2 日）报道，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋呼吁二十国集团（G20）成员 加快发展和应用人工智能 ，以促进经济增长，同时扩大数据中心等基础设施建设为 AI 产业发展提供支撑。 黄仁勋在美国为 G20 成员于北卡罗来纳州举办的一场科技活动上将 AI 比作水、电等基础设施，并呼吁每个国家都需要建设自己的基础设施，如此方能支撑本国经济。 G20 代表本周在北卡罗来纳州开会之际，美国国内反对建设数据中心的声音持续升高，并成为 11 月中期选举的重要议题。与此同时，多起 AI 模型突破安全测试环境限制的事件，也促使各国进一步要求加强监管，确保最先进 AI 系统的安全。 黄仁勋认为，对于一个国家而言，最糟糕的结果就是被甩在后头。如果公众和政策制定者 让“对 AI 的恐惧”主导讨论 ，这种风险就可能出现。“我们必须确保在讨论 AI 时保持平衡，还要更多关注 AI 提高生产力和促进繁荣的潜力。” 据IT之家了解，英伟达上周预计，下一财年销售额将增长 70%，消息推动公司股价创下 2025 年 4 月以来最大单日涨幅 。 其他大型科技公司高管也参加了这场为期两天的活动，并呼吁减少对 AI 发展的限制。SpaceX CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克也透露，自己旗下的企业已经全面押注 AI。他批评欧盟监管“严得惊人”，认为过度监管会压制增长，并主张对新兴企业减少干预。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 299 元：ANBERNIC 安伯尼克 RG 35 竖版掌机开售，RK3326 芯片、3.5 寸屏幕
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，ANBERNIC 安伯尼克 RG 35 掌机现已开售，新品采用竖版设计，可游玩各种复古游戏， 定价 299 元 。 据介绍，这款掌机搭载 RK3326 四核芯片，主频 1.5GHz，配备 1GB 内存和 64GB 存储空间。该机可游玩 NES、SNES、N64、DC、PS1、PSP 等平台的游戏，支持用户自行下载相关格式游戏。 规格方面，这款掌机搭载 3.5 英寸 IPS 屏幕，分辨率为 640*480，采用全贴合设计，带有震动马达。配备 3200mAh 电池，满电续航可达 7 小时。 IT之家附该掌机详细参数如下： 目前这款掌机已在京东开售，售价 299 元。 京东 ANBERNIC 安伯尼克 RG 35 掌机 券后 299 元 领 50 元券

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 奇瑞捷豹路虎神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄，锁单权益价 44.99 万元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者官方今晚宣布， 神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄 。 据IT之家此前报道，8 月 14 日， 奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者 8 预售发布 ，其中首发限定版正式上市（限量 1000 台），售价 45.99 万元（ 锁单权益价 44.99 万元 ）。 在 2026 成都车展上，神行者 8 迎来亮相，并在发布会上公布了 最新的权益及预售价格 ，新车叠加权益后最低 32.99 万元起： 神行者 8 PRO 版：最低 32.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX 版：最低 35.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX+ 版：最低 40.99 万元起 神行者 8 定位“豪华科技全地形 SUV”，长宽高分别为 5118mm*2050mm*1898mm，轴距 3040mm，采用 2+2+2 六座或五座布局。 座舱方面，神行者 8 搭载 46.3 英寸 Mini LED 远端屏，以及 15.6 英寸中控屏，后排配有一块 17.3 英寸吸顶屏；首搭高通骁龙 8397 车规级芯片。 动力方面，新车全系标配具备 ENC 的 1.5T 四缸增程器，热效率达到 45.79%，一升 92 号汽油可发 3.7 度电。新车全系标配双电机四驱，总功率 610kW，峰值扭矩 813N·m，零百加速 4.6 秒。 新车标配宁德时代骁遥增混全地形专用电池，容量 60.3kWh，CLTC 纯电续航 310km，采用 800V 的 6C 倍率高压增程平台，20%-80% 充电最快 12 分钟即可完成。

analysis.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者官方今晚宣布， 神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄 。 据IT之家此前报道，8 月 14 日， 奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者 8 预售发布 ，其中首发限定版正式上市（限量 1000 台），售价 45.99 万元（ 锁单权益价 44.99 万元 ）。 在 2026 成都车展上，神行者 8 迎来亮相，并在发布会上公布了 最新的权益及预售价格 ，新车叠加权益后最低 32.99 万元起： 神行者 8 PRO 版：最低 32.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX 版：最低 35.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX+ 版：最低 40.99 万元起 神行者 8 定位“豪华科技全地形 SUV”，长宽高分别为 5118mm*2050mm*1898mm，轴距 3040mm，采用 2+2+2 六座或五座布局。 座舱方面，神行者 8 搭载 46.3 英寸 Mini LED 远端屏，以及 15.6 英寸中控屏，后排配有一块 17.3 英寸吸顶屏；首搭高通骁龙 8397 车规级芯片。 动力方面，新车全系标配具备 ENC 的 1.5T 四缸增程器，热效率达到 45.79%，一升 92 号汽油可发 3.7 度电。新车全系标配双电机四驱，总功率 610kW，峰值扭矩 813N·m，零百加速 4.6 秒。 新车标配宁德时代骁遥增混全地形专用电池，容量 60.3kWh，CLTC 纯电续航 310km，采用 800V 的 6C 倍率高压增程平台，20%-80% 充电最快 12 分钟即可完成。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: vivo T5 5G 手机海外发布：天玑 7500 Turbo、6.83 英寸曲面 AMOLED 屏，34999 印度卢比起
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，vivo 今日在海外发布了 vivo T5 5G 手机（T5 4G 发布于今年 5 月），将从 9 月 9 日在印度开售，售 价 34,999 印度卢比 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,472 元人民币） 起： 6GB/128GB：售价 34,999 印度卢比 （现汇率约合 2,472 元人民币） 8GB/128GB：售价 39,999 印度卢比 （现汇率约合 2,825 元人民币） 8GB/256GB：售价 44,999 印度卢比 （现汇率约合 3,178 元人民币） 12GB/256GB：售价 49,999 印度卢比 （现汇率约合 3,532 元人民币） 核心配置方面，vivo T5 5G 搭载联发科 天玑 7500 Turbo 芯片，最高配备 12GB LPDDR4X 内存与 256GB UFS 3.1 存储；出厂预装基于 Android 16 的 OriginOS 6 系统，vivo 官方承诺为该机提供 3 次 Android 大版本升级以及长达 5 年的安全更新维护。 屏幕方面，vivo T5 5G 正面采用一块 6.83 英寸 3D 微曲 AMOLED 屏，分辨率 2800×1260、刷新率 144Hz，峰值亮度 3,000 尼特。 vivo T5 5G 手机前置 3200 万像素，后置搭载 5000 万像素主摄（索尼 IMX882、支持光学防抖）和 800 万像素超广角镜头；搭载了一块 7,050 mAh 电池，支持 44W 快充；支持 IP68 与 IP69 级防尘防水，支持湿手触控功能。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 50.98 万元，新一代理想 Mega Home 发布
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，新一代理想 Mega Home 汽车今天发布，新车只提供一种配置， 全国统一零售价 50.98 万元 ，现在下订可获赠灰白两色飞碟轮毂等配置。理想用户复购可获赠 270° 电动调光玻璃，本周内开启交付。 IT之家从发布会直播获悉，理想 Mega Home 的右舵版将在今年年底面世，登陆香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区、新加坡等右舵车市场。 外观方面，理想 Mega Home 可选灰 / 银 / 熊猫白 / 紫晶灰 / 新大象灰 5 种车色。该车新车前、后包围增加晶辉饰条装饰，新增智能三色星环灯提升精致感， 车身长宽高分别为 5355*1965*1850mm ，轴距 3300mm，提供 2.6m 长的 Sweet Home 超大迎宾光毯。 从侧面来看，新车搭载可选飞碟轮毂、黑灰低风阻轮毂等配置，采用半隐藏式门把手。尾门和后保险杠相比前代车型有所调整，凸显线条感。 内饰方面， 新一代理想 Mega Home 搭载 29 英寸 OLED 6K 全景中控屏 ，二排带有 21 英寸 OLED 4K 移动屏。搭载高通骁龙 8797 智能座舱芯片，拥有 9.3.6 无瑕星环剧院音响系统。除此之外还带有 2 颗马赫 M100 芯片、4 个激光雷达，支持新一代马赫 VLA 司机大模型。 同时，该车的乘坐体验也有较大升级。主副驾和第二排均配备零重力座椅，表面采用精致菱格纹缝线工艺，二排座椅提供头枕、腰枕和腿枕连续性软性承托功能，三排座椅还支持通风和加热。后排还带有专属小桌板， 支持“大象迎宾”模式 ， 可在开门时自动降低单侧车身高度 。 动力方面，新车采用前后双电机配置。前电机最大功率 155kW，后电机 258kW， 综合功率可达 413kW 。配备 108kWh 三元锂 5C 超充电池， CLTC 综合续航里程可达 710km ，10 分钟充电 500km。带有

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 三星首款阔折叠 Galaxy Z Fold8 体验：更宽的屏幕，更多的可能
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 7 月 22 日，三星电子在伦敦举办 Galaxy Unpacked 2026 夏季新品发布会，正式推出了第八代折叠屏家族 ——Galaxy Z 系列，共包括三款新品：主打专业 AI 生产力的“大折叠旗舰” Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra、主打纤薄便携与个性表达的“小折叠” Galaxy Z Flip8，以及最受瞩目的全新成员 —— 主打沉浸式内容与娱乐体验的“阔折叠” Galaxy Z Fold8。 三星将经典 Fold 命名让给了阔屏形态，传统大折叠顺理成章升级为 Ultra，从产品定位来讲，也确实是名正言顺。 三星首款阔折叠 Galaxy Z Fold8 而作为三星的首款“阔折叠”手机，Galaxy Z Fold8 采用了 7.6 英寸 4:3 比例的内屏与 5.5 英寸外屏，展开后宛如一台 Pad Mini。 在搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版（for Galaxy）旗舰芯片的同时，整机重量还控制在了 200g 上下。 这台新形态的三星阔折叠屏，实际体验究竟如何？ IT之家在深度使用了一段时间后，接下来就带来第一时间的体验分享。 一、外观设计篇 三星 Galaxy Z Fold 系列的设计风格向来克制，而 Galaxy Z Fold8 同样延续了这一基因。 拿到手的第一时刻，最先打动笔者的便是那种纯粹的质感 —— 这离不开它极其克制的设计语言与干净利落的造型。 纯平的正反机身配合干练的直角中框，再加上方正的宽比例机身，恍惚间，让笔者不由得想起了当年黑莓最经典的 Passport。 得益于纯直边设计，当 Galaxy Z Fold8 点亮外屏时，视觉上完全没有左右不对称的突兀感，一体感非常强，这一点相当给颜值加分。 在尺寸与重量控制上，Galaxy Z Fold8 折叠状态下厚度仅为 9.7mm，展开后薄至 4.5mm，整机重量也压在了 201g，这也是三星迄今最

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 消息称 Nexon 计划开发《星际争霸》新作，与暴雪的 IP 授权合同接近达成
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据韩媒今天报道，Nexon 计划开发《星际争霸》系列续作。该系列游戏距离最初发售已过去近 30 年，当前仍在韩国网吧热门游戏榜保持前十排名。 据匿名游戏界高层人士透露：“Nexon 与暴雪关于《星际争霸》IP 的授权合同已经接近达成。 如果本次合同签订顺利 ， Nexon 将获得《星际争霸》续作开发权 。” 如果这笔交易最终达成，其规模将相当可观。作为参考，《星际争霸》上一次发售新作还是 16 年前的《星际争霸 II：自由之翼》。 暴雪和 Nexon 暂未就上述传言作出回应，我们现在仍需要等待这笔交易正式公布。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 欧盟法院驳回 Opera 诉讼，维持微软 Edge 不受 DMA“看门人”监管决定
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据路透社报道，挪威浏览器厂商 Opera 周三在一项诉讼中败诉。该公司此前挑战欧盟反垄断监管机构的一项决定，即将微软旗下浏览器 Edge 排除在限制大型科技公司市场力量的相关监管规则之外。 欧盟委员会在 2024 年的决定中表示，尽管 Edge 符合《数字市场法》（DMA）规定的量化标准，但它并不是企业触达用户的重要“门户”。《数字市场法》为大型科技企业设定了一系列必须遵守和禁止实施的行为规范。 Opera 认为，负责执行欧盟竞争法的欧盟委员会错误地适用了相关认定标准。 总部位于卢森堡的欧盟普通法院最终支持了欧盟反垄断监管机构的决定。近年来，欧盟反垄断监管机构在针对 DMA 相关决定的多起诉讼中接连胜诉，也进一步提高了企业挑战这些监管决定的法律门槛。 法官表示：“普通法院维持欧盟委员会的决定，即不将微软在 Edge 相关业务上认定为守门人（gatekeeper）。” 法官还表示，欧盟监管机构接受了微软“有充分依据的论证”，并据此认定 Edge 并不构成一个重要的用户访问门户，因此欧盟委员会在这一过程中并未出现错误。 Opera 与微软之间的矛盾由来已久。2007 年，Opera 曾针对这家美国竞争对手提出反垄断投诉。该投诉最终促使欧盟在 2013 年对微软处以 5.61 亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 43.79 亿元人民币） 反垄断罚款，原因是微软未能向用户提供 Web 浏览器选择。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 宏碁发布 Aspire G 3D 16 笔电：AMD "Strix Halo" + 裸眼 3D 显示
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁今日在 next@acer 年度全球记者会上发布了 Aspire G 3D 16 (AG3D16-81M) 笔记本电脑。这一型号基于 AMD "Strix Halo" 芯片平台，支持裸眼 3D 显示。 Aspire G 3D 16 采用 AMD 锐龙 AI Max+ 处理器 ，支持 128GB LPDDR5X-8000 内存、2TB M.2 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD；拥有 Wi-Fi 7 无线网卡；内置 5MP IR 摄像头；提供 2 个 USB4、SD UHS-II 读卡器等接口；集成 99.9Whr 电池；整机厚度 18.3mm，质量 1.8kg。 其搭载 16" IPS 屏幕， 2D 模式分辨率 3840×2400、3D 模式分辨率 1920×2400 ，刷新率 120Hz、亮度 450nits、色域 100% DCI-P3。该笔电预装 SpatialLabs 3D Hub 应用程序，支持 2D → 3D，为用户带来立体视觉体验。 宏碁还同期推出 Aspire S 24 / 27 一体机，均基于第 3 代英特尔酷睿处理器 "Wildcat Lake"。27" 款可选 QHD 120Hz / FHD 144Hz、23.8" 则仅可选 FHD 144Hz，皆支持选配触控与数字笔支持。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁 (Acer) 今日宣布推出 2 款搭载第 3 代英特尔酷睿处理器 "Wildcat Lake" 的轻薄笔记本电脑，分别是 Swift Blade 14 (SFB14-53CF) 和 Swift Air 16 (SFA16-I31 / SFA16-I31T)。 ▲ Swift Blade 14 Swift Blade 14 仅重 799g 。其 A/D 面为碳纤维、C 面为镁铝合金，集成 50Whr 电池，配备 12GB LPDDR5-6400 内存、至高 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD 存储，拥有 Wi-Fi 6 & 蓝牙 5.3 无线网卡。 该型号可选 14" 2880×1800 90Hz 400nits OLED、1920×1200 60Hz 300nit OLED、1920×1200 60Hz 300nits IPS LCD（低色域）屏幕；集成 FHD 摄像头；提供 2 个全功能 USB-C 5Gbps、1 个 USB-C 5Gbps、1 个 3.5mm 二合一音频插孔；厚度低至 12.9mm。 ▲ Swift Air 16 Swift Air 16 则采用全铝合金机身，可选元素蓝、鼠尾草绿、砂岩金配色。其搭载 16" 2880×1800 120Hz 500nits OLED /  1920×1200 60Hz 300nit OLED / 1920×1200 60Hz 400nits IPS LCD 屏幕，支持 16GB LPDDR5X 内存与 512GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD 存储。 这款产品内置 70Whr 电池，厚度薄至 13.3~13.5mm，质量 1.5kg；提供 FHD IR 摄像头、4 扬声器系统、Wi-Fi 6E 无线网卡、2 个雷电 4、1 个 USB-A 5Gbps

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，《侠盗猎车手 V》（Grand Theft Auto V，GTA V）于 2013 年末登陆了 PS3 和 Xbox 360，随后又移植到了第八世代游戏主机。尽管这款游戏能够运行在第七世代硬件上，但 Rockstar 始终没有推出 Nintendo Switch 版本。 时隔 13 年，如今 Mod 制作者替 Rockstar 完成了这项工作。一个非官方的 《GTA V》 自制移植版现已登陆 Switch，并能够直接运行在该主机硬件上，帧率大约为 30 FPS。不过，玩家需要使用一台已经破解的 Switch，而且还必须进行超频，才能获得可玩的游戏体验。 据IT之家了解，这款移植版由 Paralympics Productions 开发，基于 2023 年泄露的 《GTA V》 源代码制作。这份源代码让 Mod 制作者得以对游戏逻辑进行逆向工程，并将其重新编译为适用于 Arm 架构的代码，使游戏能够原生运行在 Switch 搭载的 Tegra X1 SoC 上。这也意味着，从技术角度来看，《GTA V》 同样可以运行在 Android 设备上。实际上，Paralympics Productions 的 Discord 服务器也确实已经暗示，Android 移植版即将推出。 在该 Discord 服务器上，还可以找到运行这款移植版所需的全部资源。整个过程主要涉及四个关键组件：程序包构建工具、资源转换工具、修改后的配置文件以及特定的文件夹结构。这些组件会协同工作，对原版 《GTA V》 文件进行修改，构建可执行文件（.NSP），并让游戏数据兼容 Switch 使用的 Horizon OS 操作系统。 在 Discord 服务器上可以找到详细指南，包括视频教程。如果不想自己完成这些操作，也可以直接从一些 Switch 盗版网站下载已经准备好的游戏压缩包

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 本田中国回应“要求供应商大幅降价”传闻：不是官方发布的内容
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，今天（2 日）早些时候有消息称，本田已向供应商下达指令，要求其大幅降价。本田计划将部分关键零部件的成本削减 30%，其中就包括软件定义汽车相关的零部件。 据第一财经，本田中国对此回应称：“ 这不是 Honda 官方发布的内容 。关于成本优化活动，Honda 为提升全球研发、生产和采购等领域的竞争力，一直致力于与供应商的共同创新合作，持续开展相关工作。” 根据路透社今天早些时候披露的消息，本田汽车计划未来 4 年（到 2030 年）节省 1.5 万亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 630.88 亿元人民币） ，并计划在冲压与锻造零部件、电子零部件、软件定义汽车相关部件 3 个领域削减 30% 成本。联合开发计划方面，本田与日产 9 月 1 日表示，将共同开发面向软件定义汽车的标准化电子控制单元。双方计划自 2029 财年起，推出围绕该单元构建的车辆电子架构。 相关阅读： 《 路透社：本田启动 4 年降本 1.5 万亿日元计划，拟扩大采用中国制造部件 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 收购 FiveM 三年后，R 星官方 GTA 角色扮演服务器 nopixel 5 下周封测
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据外媒 Eurogamer 今天（2 日）报道，Rockstar 将进一步支持《GTA Online》的角色扮演社区， nopixel 5 将于下周启动封闭测试 。现阶段只有少数受邀玩家能够参与，其他玩家可以通过直播观看。 三年多前，R 星收购了 FiveM 背后的模组团队及技术。据悉，FiveM 是《GTA Online》最重要的角色扮演平台之一，而 R 星过去曾试图打压这类模组生态。双方合作多年后，R 星终于公布了成果： 官方角色扮演服务器 nopixel 5 。 R 星在公告博客中写道：“Rockstar 将全力支持 nopixel。长期以来，nopixel 一直凭借高度沉浸式体验和自定义地图内容重新定义角色扮演玩法。9 月 8 日起，nopixel 5 封闭测试将正式启动，少数受邀玩家可以通过 Rockstar 自己的启动器进入服务器。” 据IT之家了解，nopixel 5 封闭测试目前只向部分内容创作者和知名《GTA Online》RP 玩家开放，普通玩家下周只能通过直播观看。R 星还预告，测试期间会有“熟悉的面孔”重新饰演深受玩家喜爱的角色，也会有新人物开启自己的故事。 R 星解释道：“GTA 的角色扮演玩法实际上已把《GTA 5》改造成一个 由社区共同推动的多人版洛圣都 。玩家会扮演自己设定的角色，在一个持续运转、所有人共同参与的世界中发展个人故事。有人可以做守法市民，靠工作领取薪水；也有人可以成为罪犯寻找发财机会，城市里甚至有真正由玩家管理的警察队伍。每一次互动和每一段人际关系都会影响整个城市。” 最新版 nopixel 还将大幅改进角色创建系统，增加新的探索地点，并带来“焕新的视觉效果”和“反应更加丰富的行人”。nopixel 5 也会直接接入 R 星自己的启动器，未来全面开放后，玩家无需再借助第三方工具即可进入服务器。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 宏碁推出 Predator Atlas 7 掌机：设计更紧凑，7" FHD+ 120Hz 屏
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁 (Acer) 在本年度 COMPUTEX 上公布 8 英寸 Windows 掌机掠夺者 Predator Atlas 8 后，又在 IFA 上带来了更轻巧便携的 7 英寸机型 Predator Atlas 7。 Predator Atlas 7 核心规格与其兄弟型号基本一致 ，但屏幕缩小至 7"。其内置 80Whr 电池版本质量 ＜750g， 减重 60g ；内置 60Whr 电池版本质量＜700g， 减重 70g 。 Predator Atlas 7 搭载英特尔锐炫 G3 / G3 Extreme 处理器 ；集成至高 24GB LPDDR5X-7467 内存，支持 1TB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD；屏幕分辨率 1920×1200、刷新率 120Hz、亮度 500nits、色域 100% sRGB。 其内置双风扇散热系统（其中一颗为金属风扇），提供碳膜 / TMR 摇杆、霍尔效应模拟扳机、2 个雷电 4、microSD UHS-II 读卡器、3.5mm 音频插孔，集成 2 个 2W 扬声器。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 这是我们送玩家的礼物：CDPR 从未考虑过付费推出《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，CD Projekt RED 上周宣布推出《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》。本作将于 9 月 29 日上线，所有已经拥有游戏的玩家均可免费升级。 从商业层面来讲，免费升级重制版这种决定无疑相当慷慨，《巫师 3》的玩家们显然愿意为重制作品掏钱。CDPR 首席执行官 Michał Nowakowski 近日接受外媒 The Game Business 采访时透露， 他们从未考虑过收费 。 这名 CEO 表示：“我们正在和开发商 Fool's Theory 合作打造《旧时曲》DLC，然后就在想，为什么不让这款游戏变得更现代一些？毕竟这款游戏已经是 10 多年前开发的了。” “于是我们开始讨论改进游戏的方法。最开始只有小改动，后来逐渐发展成一个大项目，最终我们意识到，手上的东西已经变成了重制版。” “但回到你刚才提到的商业问题，我们从来没有考虑过。 我们认为真正具备商业性质的是《旧时曲》DLC ，对于《巫师 3》本体我们觉得，它应该成为 CDPR 送玩家的一份礼物。” 据IT之家了解，《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》将带来一系列改进，包括画面、玩法等多方面升级。游戏将于 9 月 29 日上线，且所有已在 GOG、Steam、Epic Games Store、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X|S 平台拥有本作的玩家均可免费升级至重制版。本作目前也已在 Battle.net 和 Nintendo Switch 2 平台开放预购（拥有 Switch 版的玩家可免费升级 Switch 2 版本）。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 福特“性价比”纯电皮卡 Fathom 实车亮相：不到 3 万美元，空间比丰田 RAV4 还大
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据外媒 motor1 今天（2 日）报道，福特主打性价比的全新皮卡 Fathom 实车首次现身拉斯维加斯。新车身披伪装，车身印有“2027 年卸下伪装”和“改变一切”等字样。 车辆起售价 28,350 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 19.1 万元人民币） ，是首款采用福特通用电动汽车平台的车型，这一架构未来还会衍生出一系列价格更加亲民的纯电产品。 入门版 Fathom 采用后轮驱动，标配成本较低的磷酸铁锂（LFP）电池。用户还可以选装前置第二台电机和更大容量的电池组，从而获得四轮驱动，容量更大的电池很可能采用另一种电池体系。 福特先进开发副总裁艾伦 · 克拉克确认，Fathom 将提供两种电池容量，其中长续航版本的 满电目标续航 483km 。 Fathom 并不只是为了吸引想买便宜纯电皮卡的普通消费者，福特明确把车队和商用客户放在了重要位置。新车采用 5 座布局，内部空间超过丰田 RAV4 荣放，希望同时兼顾工作用途和家庭用车。 配置方面，所有 Fathom 都标配 BlueCruise 免手扶驾驶、双向供电、无线 Apple CarPlay 和 Android Auto、数字钥匙、苹果地图导航 。这样的标准科技配置，即使放在价格高出两倍的部分皮卡上也并不常见。 Fathom 可以利用动力电池为工地工具供电，停电时也能为住宅提供电力。对承包商而言，这类功能显然比对普通通勤用户更有价值，也进一步体现了福特优先争取车队和商用客户的思路。 福特计划 2027 年第一季度在肯塔基州路易斯维尔装配厂开始生产原型车，并于同年晚些时候交付首批车辆。订单也将在同年初开放，与首批原型车投产时间基本一致。据悉，福特希望借 Fathom 验证这套制造方式，未来再把同样的生产模式推广到更多价格较低的纯电车型。

events.titleZh: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
events.titleEn: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
events.summaryZh: To resolve the scaling bottlenecks and runtime errors caused by monolithic system prompts, engineering teams should treat prompts as build artifacts by modularizing instructions into reusable templates. By running these modular "skill files" through a transpiler, developers can enforce static validation, catch missing dependencies at build time, and integrate prompt generation directly into their CI/CD pipelines. This deterministic approach prevents code drift and ultimately establishes a safe framework where agents can propose updates to their own logic via standard pull requests.

events.titleZh: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋呼吁 G20 成员国加快发展、应用 AI，以促进经济增长
events.titleEn: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋呼吁 G20 成员国加快发展、应用 AI，以促进经济增长
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据彭博社今天（2 日）报道，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋呼吁二十国集团（G20）成员 加快发展和应用人工智能 ，以促进经济增长，同时扩大数据中心等基础设施建设为 AI 产业发展提供支撑。 黄仁勋在美国为 G20 成员于北卡罗来纳州举办的一场科技活动上将 AI 比作水、电等基础设施，并呼吁每个国家都需要建设自己的基础设施，如此方能支撑本国经济。 G20 代表本周在北卡罗来纳州开会之际，美国国内反对建设数据中心的声音持续升高，并成为 11 月中期选举的重要议题。与此同时，多起 AI 模型突破安全测试环境限制的事件，也促使各国进一步要求加强监管，确保最先进 AI 系统的安全。 黄仁勋认为，对于一个国家而言，最糟糕的结果就是被甩在后头。如果公众和政策制定者 让“对 AI 的恐惧”主导讨论 ，这种风险就可能出现。“我们必须确保在讨论 AI 时保持平衡，还要更多关注 AI 提高生产力和促进繁荣的潜力。” 据IT之家了解，英伟达上周预计，下一财年销售额将增长 70%，消息推动公司股价创下 2025 年 4 月以来最大单日涨幅 。 其他大型科技公司高管也参加了这场为期两天的活动，并呼吁减少对 AI 发展的限制。SpaceX CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克也透露，自己旗下的企业已经全面押注 AI。他批评欧盟监管“严得惊人”，认为过度监管会压制增长，并主张对新兴企业减少干预。

events.titleZh: 奇瑞捷豹路虎神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄，锁单权益价 44.99 万元
events.titleEn: 奇瑞捷豹路虎神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄，锁单权益价 44.99 万元
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者官方今晚宣布， 神行者 8 首发限定版 1000 台售罄 。 据IT之家此前报道，8 月 14 日， 奇瑞捷豹路虎 FREELANDER 神行者 8 预售发布 ，其中首发限定版正式上市（限量 1000 台），售价 45.99 万元（ 锁单权益价 44.99 万元 ）。 在 2026 成都车展上，神行者 8 迎来亮相，并在发布会上公布了 最新的权益及预售价格 ，新车叠加权益后最低 32.99 万元起： 神行者 8 PRO 版：最低 32.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX 版：最低 35.99 万元起 神行者 8 MAX+ 版：最低 40.99 万元起 神行者 8 定位“豪华科技全地形 SUV”，长宽高分别为 5118mm*2050mm*1898mm，轴距 3040mm，采用 2+2+2 六座或五座布局。 座舱方面，神行者 8 搭载 46.3 英寸 Mini LED 远端屏，以及 15.6 英寸中控屏，后排配有一块 17.3 英寸吸顶屏；首搭高通骁龙 8397 车规级芯片。 动力方面，新车全系标配具备 ENC 的 1.5T 四缸增程器，热效率达到 45.79%，一升 92 号汽油可发 3.7 度电。新车全系标配双电机四驱，总功率 610kW，峰值扭矩 813N·m，零百加速 4.6 秒。 新车标配宁德时代骁遥增混全地形专用电池，容量 60.3kWh，CLTC 纯电续航 310km，采用 800V 的 6C 倍率高压增程平台，20%-80% 充电最快 12 分钟即可完成。

events.titleZh: 欧盟法院驳回 Opera 诉讼，维持微软 Edge 不受 DMA“看门人”监管决定
events.titleEn: 欧盟法院驳回 Opera 诉讼，维持微软 Edge 不受 DMA“看门人”监管决定
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据路透社报道，挪威浏览器厂商 Opera 周三在一项诉讼中败诉。该公司此前挑战欧盟反垄断监管机构的一项决定，即将微软旗下浏览器 Edge 排除在限制大型科技公司市场力量的相关监管规则之外。 欧盟委员会在 2024 年的决定中表示，尽管 Edge 符合《数字市场法》（DMA）规定的量化标准，但它并不是企业触达用户的重要“门户”。《数字市场法》为大型科技企业设定了一系列必须遵守和禁止实施的行为规范。 Opera 认为，负责执行欧盟竞争法的欧盟委员会错误地适用了相关认定标准。 总部位于卢森堡的欧盟普通法院最终支持了欧盟反垄断监管机构的决定。近年来，欧盟反垄断监管机构在针对 DMA 相关决定的多起诉讼中接连胜诉，也进一步提高了企业挑战这些监管决定的法律门槛。 法官表示：“普通法院维持欧盟委员会的决定，即不将微软在 Edge 相关业务上认定为守门人（gatekeeper）。” 法官还表示，欧盟监管机构接受了微软“有充分依据的论证”，并据此认定 Edge 并不构成一个重要的用户访问门户，因此欧盟委员会在这一过程中并未出现错误。 Opera 与微软之间的矛盾由来已久。2007 年，Opera 曾针对这家美国竞争对手提出反垄断投诉。该投诉最终促使欧盟在 2013 年对微软处以 5.61 亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 43.79 亿元人民币） 反垄断罚款，原因是微软未能向用户提供 Web 浏览器选择。

events.titleEn: 宏碁发布 Aspire G 3D 16 笔电：AMD "Strix Halo" + 裸眼 3D 显示
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁今日在 next@acer 年度全球记者会上发布了 Aspire G 3D 16 (AG3D16-81M) 笔记本电脑。这一型号基于 AMD "Strix Halo" 芯片平台，支持裸眼 3D 显示。 Aspire G 3D 16 采用 AMD 锐龙 AI Max+ 处理器 ，支持 128GB LPDDR5X-8000 内存、2TB M.2 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD；拥有 Wi-Fi 7 无线网卡；内置 5MP IR 摄像头；提供 2 个 USB4、SD UHS-II 读卡器等接口；集成 99.9Whr 电池；整机厚度 18.3mm，质量 1.8kg。 其搭载 16" IPS 屏幕， 2D 模式分辨率 3840×2400、3D 模式分辨率 1920×2400 ，刷新率 120Hz、亮度 450nits、色域 100% DCI-P3。该笔电预装 SpatialLabs 3D Hub 应用程序，支持 2D → 3D，为用户带来立体视觉体验。 宏碁还同期推出 Aspire S 24 / 27 一体机，均基于第 3 代英特尔酷睿处理器 "Wildcat Lake"。27" 款可选 QHD 120Hz / FHD 144Hz、23.8" 则仅可选 FHD 144Hz，皆支持选配触控与数字笔支持。

events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据外媒 Eurogamer 今天（2 日）报道，Rockstar 将进一步支持《GTA Online》的角色扮演社区， nopixel 5 将于下周启动封闭测试 。现阶段只有少数受邀玩家能够参与，其他玩家可以通过直播观看。 三年多前，R 星收购了 FiveM 背后的模组团队及技术。据悉，FiveM 是《GTA Online》最重要的角色扮演平台之一，而 R 星过去曾试图打压这类模组生态。双方合作多年后，R 星终于公布了成果： 官方角色扮演服务器 nopixel 5 。 R 星在公告博客中写道：“Rockstar 将全力支持 nopixel。长期以来，nopixel 一直凭借高度沉浸式体验和自定义地图内容重新定义角色扮演玩法。9 月 8 日起，nopixel 5 封闭测试将正式启动，少数受邀玩家可以通过 Rockstar 自己的启动器进入服务器。” 据IT之家了解，nopixel 5 封闭测试目前只向部分内容创作者和知名《GTA Online》RP 玩家开放，普通玩家下周只能通过直播观看。R 星还预告，测试期间会有“熟悉的面孔”重新饰演深受玩家喜爱的角色，也会有新人物开启自己的故事。 R 星解释道：“GTA 的角色扮演玩法实际上已把《GTA 5》改造成一个 由社区共同推动的多人版洛圣都 。玩家会扮演自己设定的角色，在一个持续运转、所有人共同参与的世界中发展个人故事。有人可以做守法市民，靠工作领取薪水；也有人可以成为罪犯寻找发财机会，城市里甚至有真正由玩家管理的警察队伍。每一次互动和每一段人际关系都会影响整个城市。” 最新版 nopixel 还将大幅改进角色创建系统，增加新的探索地点，并带来“焕新的视觉效果”和“反应更加丰富的行人”。nopixel 5 也会直接接入 R 星自己的启动器，未来全面开放后，玩家无需再借助第三方工具即可进入服务器。

events.titleZh: 宏碁推出 Predator Atlas 7 掌机：设计更紧凑，7" FHD+ 120Hz 屏
events.titleEn: 宏碁推出 Predator Atlas 7 掌机：设计更紧凑，7" FHD+ 120Hz 屏
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，宏碁 (Acer) 在本年度 COMPUTEX 上公布 8 英寸 Windows 掌机掠夺者 Predator Atlas 8 后，又在 IFA 上带来了更轻巧便携的 7 英寸机型 Predator Atlas 7。 Predator Atlas 7 核心规格与其兄弟型号基本一致 ，但屏幕缩小至 7"。其内置 80Whr 电池版本质量 ＜750g， 减重 60g ；内置 60Whr 电池版本质量＜700g， 减重 70g 。 Predator Atlas 7 搭载英特尔锐炫 G3 / G3 Extreme 处理器 ；集成至高 24GB LPDDR5X-7467 内存，支持 1TB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD；屏幕分辨率 1920×1200、刷新率 120Hz、亮度 500nits、色域 100% sRGB。 其内置双风扇散热系统（其中一颗为金属风扇），提供碳膜 / TMR 摇杆、霍尔效应模拟扳机、2 个雷电 4、microSD UHS-II 读卡器、3.5mm 音频插孔，集成 2 个 2W 扬声器。

events.titleZh: 这是我们送玩家的礼物：CDPR 从未考虑过付费推出《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》
events.titleEn: 这是我们送玩家的礼物：CDPR 从未考虑过付费推出《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，CD Projekt RED 上周宣布推出《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》。本作将于 9 月 29 日上线，所有已经拥有游戏的玩家均可免费升级。 从商业层面来讲，免费升级重制版这种决定无疑相当慷慨，《巫师 3》的玩家们显然愿意为重制作品掏钱。CDPR 首席执行官 Michał Nowakowski 近日接受外媒 The Game Business 采访时透露， 他们从未考虑过收费 。 这名 CEO 表示：“我们正在和开发商 Fool's Theory 合作打造《旧时曲》DLC，然后就在想，为什么不让这款游戏变得更现代一些？毕竟这款游戏已经是 10 多年前开发的了。” “于是我们开始讨论改进游戏的方法。最开始只有小改动，后来逐渐发展成一个大项目，最终我们意识到，手上的东西已经变成了重制版。” “但回到你刚才提到的商业问题，我们从来没有考虑过。 我们认为真正具备商业性质的是《旧时曲》DLC ，对于《巫师 3》本体我们觉得，它应该成为 CDPR 送玩家的一份礼物。” 据IT之家了解，《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》将带来一系列改进，包括画面、玩法等多方面升级。游戏将于 9 月 29 日上线，且所有已在 GOG、Steam、Epic Games Store、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X|S 平台拥有本作的玩家均可免费升级至重制版。本作目前也已在 Battle.net 和 Nintendo Switch 2 平台开放预购（拥有 Switch 版的玩家可免费升级 Switch 2 版本）。

events.titleZh: 福特“性价比”纯电皮卡 Fathom 实车亮相：不到 3 万美元，空间比丰田 RAV4 还大
events.titleEn: 福特“性价比”纯电皮卡 Fathom 实车亮相：不到 3 万美元，空间比丰田 RAV4 还大
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 2 日消息，据外媒 motor1 今天（2 日）报道，福特主打性价比的全新皮卡 Fathom 实车首次现身拉斯维加斯。新车身披伪装，车身印有“2027 年卸下伪装”和“改变一切”等字样。 车辆起售价 28,350 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 19.1 万元人民币） ，是首款采用福特通用电动汽车平台的车型，这一架构未来还会衍生出一系列价格更加亲民的纯电产品。 入门版 Fathom 采用后轮驱动，标配成本较低的磷酸铁锂（LFP）电池。用户还可以选装前置第二台电机和更大容量的电池组，从而获得四轮驱动，容量更大的电池很可能采用另一种电池体系。 福特先进开发副总裁艾伦 · 克拉克确认，Fathom 将提供两种电池容量，其中长续航版本的 满电目标续航 483km 。 Fathom 并不只是为了吸引想买便宜纯电皮卡的普通消费者，福特明确把车队和商用客户放在了重要位置。新车采用 5 座布局，内部空间超过丰田 RAV4 荣放，希望同时兼顾工作用途和家庭用车。 配置方面，所有 Fathom 都标配 BlueCruise 免手扶驾驶、双向供电、无线 Apple CarPlay 和 Android Auto、数字钥匙、苹果地图导航 。这样的标准科技配置，即使放在价格高出两倍的部分皮卡上也并不常见。 Fathom 可以利用动力电池为工地工具供电，停电时也能为住宅提供电力。对承包商而言，这类功能显然比对普通通勤用户更有价值，也进一步体现了福特优先争取车队和商用客户的思路。 福特计划 2027 年第一季度在肯塔基州路易斯维尔装配厂开始生产原型车，并于同年晚些时候交付首批车辆。订单也将在同年初开放，与首批原型车投产时间基本一致。据悉，福特希望借 Fathom 验证这套制造方式，未来再把同样的生产模式推广到更多价格较低的纯电车型。

events.titleZh: Video generation models as world simulators
events.titleEn: Video generation models as world simulators
events.summaryZh: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.
events.summaryEn: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

sourceChain.title: Video generation models as world simulators

events.summaryZh: We’re developing a blueprint for evaluating the risk that a large language model (LLM) could aid someone in creating a biological threat. In an evaluation involving both biology experts and students, we found that GPT-4 provides at most a mild uplift in biological threat creation accuracy.
